description: Freeze before new evaluation; exploratory, after original final inspection.
selection_rule: Include always-own. Eligible candidates have selection native score and mean accuracy at least task-ID, and worst accuracy at most .01 lower. Maximize native score, then mean accuracy, then minimize switching; baseline wins remaining ties. This is a selection constraint, not a final safety guarantee.
benefit_target: For each expert, expert correctness minus own-expert correctness on fit labels. Ridge predicts four gains from standardized frozen base features plus known task one-hot. Set own gain to zero and route only above a fixed threshold.
lambda_ties: Prefer the smaller lambda; use frozen per-lambda step selected on coefficient_selection.
official_validation: Pinned full GLUE validation, per-task deduplicated and filtered against normalized full text tuples from ALL original train examples across the four tasks. Selection is locked first. Official validation was explored historically and is not a pristine blind test. Near duplicates and pretraining contamination are not ruled out.
deployment: Cached expert logits are offline analysis. Extra feature pass/grouped expert forwards remain; no latency advantage is claimed without a new same-device serving benchmark.
